new_evidence_family: Binance public 'metrics' archive (data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/{symbol}/), 5-minute granularity: open interest, top-trader position ratio, global retail long/short account ratio, taker buy/sell volume ratio. Same free, unauthenticated host already used for klines/fundingRate. No prior strategy in this codebase (S1-S17b) has used this data in a backtest, even though ingester/models.py already carries live DB models for it (OpenInterest, LongShortRatio, TopTraderPosition) used only by the live analysts.volume_flow agent.

hypotheses.bars: closed 15m; execution no earlier than next 1m open
hypotheses.regime: identical to S16/S17: 4h EMA200 trend+slope confirmed by 1h ADX(14) >= 20
hypotheses.structure: identical order-block detection to S17 (first-touch trigger, not S17b's rejection variant, since S17 had the better development PF of the two): displacement >=1.5x ATR within 3 bars, 3-bar peak volume >=1.2x trailing-20-bar average, confirmed 3 bars after formation, zone active up to 32 bars, consumed on first touch
hypotheses.flow: OBV must still be on the trend side of its own EMA(9) at the touch bar (identical to S17)
hypotheses.positioning: open interest change over the prior 8 bars (2h) must be non-negative for LONG (new long positioning behind the rally, not a pure short squeeze) and non-positive for SHORT (mirrored) — the price/OI quadrant used by derivatives desks (price up + OI up = healthy continuation; price up + OI down = squeeze more likely to fade)
hypotheses.risk: stop = zone boundary opposite the trend direction, minus/plus 0.15 ATR buffer; actual-fill stop width clamped 0.50-3.00 ATR
hypotheses.exit: identical to S16/S17/S17b: breakeven-then-chandelier trailing activated at +1.0R, trail at best-price minus 1.5x ATR (ATR frozen at entry); 5.0R hard cap; 240 minute time stop

hypotheses.positioning: identical to H1, PLUS: the top-trader position ratio z-score (vs its own trailing 672-bar / ~7-day mean and population std) must NOT be at or beyond +/-1.5 in the SAME direction as the trade at the touch bar — avoiding entries where large accounts are already at a statistical positioning extreme in the trade's own direction

execution_intentionally_identical_to_s16: so any performance delta versus S17 is attributable ONLY to the OI/positioning confirmation

symbols.note: No BTC reference series is used.

windows.warmup_rationale: same 4h EMA200 convergence rationale as S16/S17; also gives the top-trader z-score its full 672-bar (~7 day) baseline well before development starts

promotion_gates.development_to_validation: PF >1.05, net PnL >0, at least 40 fills
promotion_gates.validation_to_retrospective_evaluation: base PF >1.10, stress PF >=1.00, at least 20 base fills, at least 2/3 symbols net positive, no symbol >60% gross profit
promotion_gates.paper_to_live: at least 200 prospective candidates across three full frozen months, PF >=1.25 base and >=1.10 stress, expectancy >=0.10R, 95% session-block bootstrap lower bound >0, max DD <=4%

execution.one_global_position: single global minute event loop with one shared cash balance, pending order and open position across the correlated ETH/SOL/BNB cluster
execution.ambiguous_bar: stop first; no favorable exit on limit fill minute

selection: Exactly H1 and H2 central configurations. No parameter grid over the OI lookback window, the z-score window, or the extreme threshold (fixed at 1.5, a conventional statistical-extreme cutoff, not tuned on this data). A failing gate stops that route; choose no least-bad winner.
stress_semantics: Stress and severe are deployability replays: higher costs and limit penetration are known before entry, so the reward/cost filter is reapplied and the fill cohort may shrink.
known_limitations: Open interest and top-trader ratios are exchange-wide (Binance) aggregates, not a reconstruction of the full order book or cross-exchange positioning.

Metrics snapshots are treated as known at their own timestamp (same treatment as funding-rate settlement elsewhere in this codebase) with small gaps forward-filled — Binance's own metrics feed is not gap-free, unlike 1-minute klines.
Same order-block, ATR-freeze and no-order-book-reconstruction simplifications as S17.
This is a retrospective diagnostic; not a live paper-forward result.
